description.narrative: This project presents a transformative initiative to establish an inclusive, credible, and equitable electoral process in Madagascar, by addressing immediate barriers to youth’s and women’s participation while tackling systemic inequities. It will also strengthen the institutional capacities of the electoral management body (CENI) by providing high technology equipment to manage a biometric electoral register database. The project strives to address these systemic obstacles and to foster sustainable democratic resilience before the new electoral cycle begins in 2028/2029 and to ensure massive annual voters’ registration in the meantime. By leveraging this opportunity, the project aims to sensitize critical masses of women and youth to participate in the democratic and electoral processes, to plant the seed for biometric voters registration systems, to empower marginalized populations, and to strengthen the CENI.Furthermore, it aims also to strengthen the role of women leaders as agents of change in preventing conflict and promoting social cohesion, while improving the CENI’s ability to manage voter registration in an effective and transparent manner..

title.narrative: Strngthening women's and youth's participation and voter registration in the electoral process in Madagascar
